phases.objective: Reject changed implemented contracts with missing, untracked, non-regular, or path-escaping evidence; reject evidence deletion or rename when any unchanged implemented contract still references the retired path; and reject deleting or renaming an E2E contract without an explicit reviewed retirement path.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-head changed-file diff, repository E2E contract index, filesystem path chain, and Git stage-zero index
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: New contract drift, deleted or renamed contract identities, deleted evidence references, symlink components, realpath escapes, untracked files, non-stage-zero Git objects, and non-regular files fail on the originating pull request, while a separately dispatched full audit can enumerate historical drift without widening mutation authority.
steps: Build the exact changed-file and rename/deletion set from base...head.
Index Spec and non-Spec E2E contracts and their implemented journey evidence paths.
Reject deleted or renamed E2E contract identities unless a separately reviewed retirement mechanism is introduced.
Validate every changed contract and every unchanged contract affected by a deleted or renamed evidence path.
Resolve every path component with lstat and realpath semantics, rejecting symlink components and repository-root escapes.
Require each targeted contract and evidence path to be tracked at Git stage zero with regular blob mode 100644 or 100755.
Emit one canonical secret-free report and fail closed on invalid, missing, deleted, renamed, untracked, symbolic-link, escaping, or non-regular references.
assertions: A changed `.changes/e2e` or Spec contract cannot bypass evidence validation.
Deleting or renaming an E2E contract fails closed and requires an explicit separately reviewed retirement path.
Deleting or renaming evidence is rejected when any implemented contract still references the old path.
Every targeted contract and implemented evidence path must remain lexically and physically inside the repository, with no symbolic-link component.
Every targeted path must be tracked at Git stage zero as a regular 100644 or 100755 blob; untracked files and mode 120000 links are rejected.
Unrelated historical drift is not silently expanded into a pull-request blocker; workflow dispatch provides the explicit full-audit mode.
The workflow uses exact pull-request head checkout, read-only contents permission, persisted credentials disabled, and a bounded artifact.
No database, provider, credential, deployment, external-send, Production, force-push, or protected-branch authority is granted.

phases.objective: Publish trusted pull-request summaries and make the integrity workflow a required protected-branch status after observation.
Add an explicit reviewed contract-retirement protocol and bounded cleanup workflow if the full repository audit identifies historical debt outside active changes.
The guard operates entirely on repository contracts and has no external canary target.
The guard does not deploy, apply migrations, call providers, or mutate Production.
